items.name: Narin
items.tip: Already built and at rank 23 - only 7 ranks left. Bring Narin into any Steel Path or Zariman mission and she'll be done in a run or two.

items.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
items.tip: Kuva weapons go past 30. Each Forma raises the max rank by 2, so it takes 5 Forma total to reach rank 40. Mastery is based on the highest rank it ever reached, so level it back up after each Forma. Worth 4,000 XP at rank 40.

items.name: Sagek Prime
items.tip: A Grineer-made prime, not a relic prime: every part drops from The Perita Rebellion missions in the Dark Refractory on Deimos (about 5.7% per part). Farm it alongside Galariak Prime - same missions.

items.name: Akarius
items.tip: Blueprint drops from Demolisher units in Disruption missions (Kappa on Sedna and Apollo on Lua are popular). Also needs Hexenon (Jupiter), Nano Spores and Neurodes.

items.name: Lato Vandal
items.tip: All parts drop from Elite Sanctuary Onslaught (Simaris, Sanctuary on the Relay). Pick a fast nuke frame and push to rotation C.

items.name: Akmagnus Prime
items.tip: Needs 2x Magnus Prime as ingredients - build them first; Magnus Prime counts for mastery too if it isn't already mastered.

items.name: Wrath
items.tip: Orion's heavy scythe. Parts drop from Railjack Skirmish missions in the Uranus Proxima.

items.name: Twin Kohmak
items.tip: Blueprint drops from Kela De Thaym (Merrow, Sedna). Also needs 2x Kohmak (blueprint in the Market) and a Forma - Kohmak is extra mastery if it isn't mastered yet.

items.name: Pride
items.tip: Sirius' heavy scythe. Parts drop from Railjack Skirmish missions in the Uranus Proxima.

items.name: Styanax Prime
items.tip: Already owned - just needs leveling. 6,000 XP sitting in the arsenal.

items.name: Corvas Prime
items.tip: Arch-gun. Can be leveled in Archwing missions or on the Plains / Orb Vallis / Cambion Drift with the Archgun Deployer gear item.

items.name: Corufell Prime
items.tip: Arch-melee - level it in Archwing missions (e.g. Railjack, Archwing nodes on the star chart).

items.name: Braton Vandal
items.tip: All parts drop from Elite Sanctuary Onslaught - farm it together with the Lato Vandal.

items.name: Cinta
items.tip: Duviri weapon - check the wiki for the current Acrithis / Circuit rotation that sells the parts.

items.name: Haalvu
items.tip: Sentient multi-barrel rifle added in July 2026 - see the wiki link for how to get it.

items.name: Thornbak
items.tip: Free reward from The Teacher quest - comes with its own slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

items.name: Akvasto Prime
items.tip: Needs 2x Vasto Prime as ingredients (also vaulted) - check Varzia's rotation or buy the set on warframe.market.

items.name: Venato
items.tip: Caliban's signature scythe. The blueprint is in the Market. Needs Exceptional Sentient Cores and Anomaly Shards (Sentient anomaly in the Veil), Iradite and Narmer Isoplast.

items.name: Morgha
items.tip: Arch-gun. Blueprint comes from Necraloid on Deimos (Clearance: Odima). Level it with the Archgun Deployer in open worlds.

items.name: Feverspine
items.tip: Infested K-Drive (Velocipod) deck from the Entrati in the Necralisk on Deimos. A K-Drive counts like a Warframe (6,000 XP) - level it by doing tricks on the Cambion Drift.

items.name: Sporothrix
items.tip: Parts drop from the level 50-60 Isolation Vaults on the Cambion Drift. Necraloid also sells them.

items.name: Korrudo
items.tip: Blueprint drops from Thumpers on the Plains of Eidolon (Narmer / Tusk Thumper Bull & Doma). Needs Mawfish Bones (fishing) and Breath of the Eidolon.

items.name: Spectra Vandal
items.tip: All parts come from Railjack caches in the Veil Proxima.

items.name: Arum Spinosa
items.tip: Parts drop from the level 40-50 Isolation Vaults on the Cambion Drift. Necraloid (Clearance: Modus) also sells them.

items.name: Athodai
items.tip: All parts come from Railjack caches in the Venus Proxima.

items.name: Galariak Prime
items.tip: Grineer-made prime, not a relic prime: parts drop from The Perita Rebellion missions in the Dark Refractory on Deimos - same farm as Sagek Prime.

items.name: Hespar
items.tip: Zariman heavy scythe. Blueprint from the level 90-95 Zariman bounty; blade and handle drop from Void Armageddon / Void Cascade.

nodes.name: Acheron
nodes.tip: Locked - unlocks after you finish Oceanum.

nodes.name: Yursa
nodes.tip: Locked - unlocks after you finish Salacia.
